trigger: Run only if the completed 22-cohort v3 budget checkpoint fails its already-declared deterministic development competence gate. Never evaluate interim checkpoints for this decision.
checkpoint_rule: The final budget_checkpoint.pt from uniform_completion_170_v3_r01, with hash matched to verified evidence/uniform_completion_v3.json before launch.

motivation.scope: CPU analytic readout on all active saved v2 deterministic observations; no new controller or motion outcome was evaluated.

formula: E[clip(X,-1,1)] = mu*(Phi(b)-Phi(a)) + sigma*(phi(a)-phi(b)) - Phi(a) + 1 - Phi(b); a=(-1-mu)/sigma, b=(1-mu)/sigma.
analytic_verification: Independent numerical integration at 100001 points agrees within 7.3e-10 on declared CPU cases; symmetry, bounds and no RNG consumption tested.
invariants: Same final checkpoint and actor/critic instantiation in every path
Same v3 reward, geometry, raw 20 N abort, physical gravity, 30 s deadline and 0.5 s dwell
Exact initialization tensors, sensor draws and nuisance streams compared
Separate stochastic-policy generator; no policy or reward tuning during diagnosis
readouts: All complete jobs, nominal/fault bins, force aborts and other failures
Full upstream and corrected returns with completion-credit ledger
Action targets, requested/applied actions, physical motion, contacts and witnessed recoveries
Bitwise reproduction of the original final-budget deterministic evaluation
decision_rule: Report every arm and uncertainty. Any later adoption of a different extraction requires a new shared comparison protocol and predeclared all-development-seed confirmation; this diagnostic cannot replace the original v3 gate result.
scope_and_limitations: Conditional development diagnosis, not a training arm, final-test result, or adaptive comparison.
Mean action after clipping differs from clipping the Gaussian mean; neither guarantees best physical control.
No new GPU job runs concurrently with the registered training or its required evaluations.
If the original competence gate passes, skip this diagnostic and follow the authorized adaptive-sampler next step.
